page.overview:
Who is Bowman Wright?

Bowman Wright (1492–1560) was a half-blood wizard and a skilled metal charmer who lived in Godric's Hollow sometime during the Middle Ages.

Born to a witch mother and a Muggle father, he invented the Golden Snitch as a replacement for the endangered Golden Snidget, combining his interest in science, magic, and sports.

Bowman Wright was buried in Godric's Hollow. His grave was one of the oldest graves in St Jerome's graveyard.

During the Calamity in the late 2010s or early 2020s, a Calamity Investigator working for the Statute of Secrecy Task Force reviewed the works of Bowman Wright to learn more about his design for the Golden Snitch. The investigator was impressed by Wright's design and wondered how the Snitch really worked.
